issue_title: [Security] load() follows symlinks when reading JSON file, potentially allowing symlink att
fix_summary: Add symlink protection to load() method to prevent symlink attacks

added: Symlink check in load() method that raises SecurityError if path is a symlink
test_load_rejects_symlink_db_file - Verifies load() rejects symlinks to sensitive files
test_load_succeeds_with_regular_file_after_symlink_fix - Verifies normal file loading still works
test_load_rejects_symlink_to_nonexistent_file - Verifies broken symlinks are also rejected

security_fix.fix_approach: Check is_symlink() before reading the file, raise SecurityError if symlink detected
security_fix.verification: All 9 tests pass including 3 new tests for issue #5310
